title: Hear What Byrna Owners Have to Say with 850,000 Launchers Sold
summary: Hear what real Byrna owners have to say after 850,000 launchers sold. Discover why customers choose Byrna for less-lethal self-defense, everyday carry, and personal protection.
body_markdown:
## Why Byrna Owners Choose the Byrna SD and CL for Self-Defense


For many people considering a[personal safety tool](https://byrna.com/collections/byrna-non-lethal-guns) , finding an option that fits their lifestyle, comfort level, and preparedness goals is an important part of the decision. In a recent collection of Byrna owner testimonials, users shared why they chose Byrna launchers, including the


[Byrna SD](https://byrna.com/products/byrna-sd-non-lethal-self-defense-pistol) and


[Byrna CL](https://byrna.com/products/byrna-compact-launcher-universal-kit) , and how the experience has shaped their approach to self-defense.


### Byrna Owners Share Their Experiences


Several owners highlighted the Byrna SD as a trusted option for everyday carry. Its ability to provide a less-lethal self-defense alternative has made it a popular choice among people looking for additional peace of mind while going about their daily routines.


The Byrna CL was also praised for its compact design. One owner described carrying the launcher in a pocket, while another highlighted the convenience of pairing a Byrna launcher with a dedicated carry bag.


For some owners, confidence comes from knowing the product is used by law enforcement professionals and departments. The perception that Byrna can provide an additional option for personal protection was cited as an important reason for choosing the platform.


### Finding the Right Self-Defense Option


The testimonials also emphasize that personal safety decisions are highly individual. A pistol instructor featured in the video encourages prospective firearm owners to understand their own capabilities and comfort level before making a decision.


For those looking for a less-lethal alternative, the Byrna experience offers an opportunity to become familiar with a launcher without the recoil associated with traditional firearms. Hands-on experience can help users better understand the platform and determine whether it fits their needs.


### Confidence Through Familiarity


Whether choosing the Byrna SD for everyday carry or the compact Byrna CL for portability, owners consistently point to familiarity, convenience, and confidence as key benefits.


For anyone exploring less-lethal self-defense options, training and understanding the equipment are essential steps toward becoming better prepared.
